style: Painterly anime landscape illustration in the same style as the attached reference image: soft visible brushwork, warm cinematic light, rich but not oversaturated colours, high detail. Absolutely no characters, no creatures, no people, no text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no frame.

backdrop.brief: Low camera, eye level, looking across a wide flat open area toward the horizon. The horizon sits at about 38% from the top. The lower 60% of the image is a broad, flat, uncluttered ground surface (it will be covered by a game board), with interest and scenery only near the horizon and at the far left and right edges.

texture.brief: Perfectly top-down orthographic view of a ground surface texture, flat even lighting, no perspective, no horizon, no cast shadows from objects, no large distinct features, uniform density across the whole image so it can tile seamlessly. Painterly, matching the reference's palette.
